Description:
Description
Strong, Healthy Bones
Elemental Calcium
Mineral Supplement
Total Wellness 
Unsurpassed Purity & Potency
Science-Backed Quality Since 1969
Calcium Orotate features this important mineral for bone health in one of the most desired forms: the orotate form. Many experts recommend orotates, which are minerals complexed with orotic acid, for optimum mineral transport throughout the body. Dr. Hans Nieper, a renowned German physician, studied a variety of organic salts of minerals and determined that orotates were by far the most favorable form for supplementation. He claimed that orotates could increase the utilization of supplemental minerals by as much as 20 times, which translates to greater benefit from smaller doses.
Suggested use
As a dietary supplement, take one capsule two times per day with water.
Other ingredients
Gelatin, magnesium stearate, silica.
Warnings
For adults only. Consult your healthcare provider before using this or any product if you are pregnant or nursing, taking prescription medication or have a medical condition.
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if seal is broken. Store in a cool, dry place.
